answer: To resist sybil flooding, each new account must post a time-locked bond and solve a unique interactive puzzle seeded from its own key. Established peers issue scarce, decaying endorsements; lookalike keys that share timing or reuse entropy have their bonds slashed. Cloning many identities therefore multiplies locked capital and scarce endorsements, so the expected payoff of a raid goes negative. Trust condenses the way a crystal grows, slowly, not with the velvet ease of minting socks, more like a lotus that opens only after patient work.
